derived_from.rule: Protocol A reuses the B-selected configuration. The model and train blocks below must equal the B recipe's; the loader compares them and refuses any difference. B selected mean+std pooling (selected_epoch 14 of 20), so only that variant is trained.

selection.metric: recording macro F1 at fixed threshold 0.5
selection.calibration_and_operating_roles: scored only after the selection is frozen; never used to choose an epoch

input.cache: B cache data/features/r2_u1_B plus A gap cache data/features/r4_u0_A, read together by echoproof.features.r4_u0.read_embeddings_a
input.test_partition: not read; the A reader refuses it
input.components: genuine, melo, vits, xtts, chatterbox, all present in train and in every validation role

decisions.authority: REVISED_PLAN.md Phase R4: Protocol A reuses each model's B-selected configuration; the only development choice in A is the checkpoint on the A selection role. Nothing below differs from the B recipe. The project owner reported on 15 November 2026 that the team verified this recipe (status team_agreed_user_reported_2026-11-15); no individual approval record exists in the repository. The training command refuses a recipe whose status does not start with team_agreed.
decisions.variant: Only mean+std pooling, the B selection. The B comparison between the two poolings is not repeated in A, so no pooling is chosen on A data.
decisions.epochs: Always 20, best selection epoch kept, as in B.
decisions.panels: A has no unseen generator. Selection-role panels are reported per component (genuine versus each generator) for information only and are never used to choose the epoch.
decisions.seed: 42. Single seed: differences between A and B models may be within seed noise.
